citation_and_permissions_readme:
St Lucia is collected by driving a car with a for-
ward facing camera around the riverside suburb of St Lucia,
Brisbane. Of the nine drives, we use the first and the last
one as database and queries. Given the high density of the
images (extracted from videos), we select only one frame
every 5 meters

Michael Milford and G. Wyeth. Mapping a suburb with a sin-
gle camera using a biologically inspired slam system. IEEE
Transactions on Robotics, 24:1038–1053, 2008
known_sampling_limit: Ordered source frame IDs retained, not uniformly sampled video. Velocity is index step, not physical speed. Gaps and geographic steps disclosed.
